title: Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines
abstract: arXiv:2611.13413v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1's 203 GB of Engram n-gram tables sit in host DRAM today, taking 190 of the 223 GiB a 4-GPU serving process uses. Row indices depend only on input tokens, so reads can start with each step and overlap earlier layers. V4.1's two Engram layers have windows that differ by 30x (0.3 vs. 9.3 ms). We show that this deadline, together with session reuse and contention on a shared device, decides which tier each table can use and which layers need cache, and we give a model that predicts the resulting slowdown from measured read times. Agent and chat traffic reuse rows within sessions, and static hot sets transfer poorly. We build SlackTier, a table tier for SGLang that issues all lookups at step start. It reads the short-window layer first and splits a small GPU row cache across layers. The path runs inside the decode CUDA graph and is bit-exact with the original gather. translated_title: 基于逐层预取时限的大语言模型查找表放置
translated_abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1 的 203 GB Engram n-gram 表目前存放在主机 DRAM 中，占用了 4-GPU 推理进程所用 223 GiB 内存中的 190 GiB。由于行索引仅取决于输入 token，读取可以在每一步开始时就发起，并与较早层的计算重叠。V4.1 的两个 Engram 层的预取窗口相差 30 倍（0.3 ms 对 9.3 ms）。我们证明，这一时限连同会话内的行复用以及对共享设备的争用，决定了每张表可以放在哪个存储层级、哪些层需要缓存，并且我们给出了一个可根据实测读取时间预测由此产生的性能下降的模型。智能体和聊天流量会在会话内复用行，而静态热集的迁移效果不佳。我们构建了 SlackTier，这是面向 SGLang 的一个表层级，它在步骤开始时发出所有查找，先读取短窗口层，并将一个小的 GPU 行缓存跨层拆分。该路径运行在解码 CUDA 图内部，并与原始 gather 操作位精确一致。第 14 层的表可以放在不带缓存的 NVMe 上，而没有可测量的
tldr: 提出 SlackTier，利用逐层预取时限（两个 Engram 层窗口相差 30 倍）将 LLM 的大规模 n-gram 查找表按层放置到不同存储层级，在解码 CUDA 图内实现位精确查找，使部分表可无需缓存直接放在 NVMe 上而几乎不损失性能。
en_tdlr: SlackTier places LLM n-gram lookup tables in storage tiers based on per-layer prefetch deadlines (differing 30x between Engram layers), issuing all lookups at step start inside the decode CUDA graph bit-exactly, so large tables can sit uncached on NVMe with no measurable slowdown.
